# Requirements Quality Checklist: DEV-334 browser smoke

**Purpose**: Reviewer questions about whether the specification states the three smoke scenarios, the isolated stack, and the CI evidence completely, clearly, and consistently
**Created**: 2026-10-19
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md)

**Note**: Generated by `/speckit-checklist` after `/speckit-clarify`. Depth is standard. Audience is a reviewer before Gate 1. Focus is the smoke contract and provider isolation. Items test the requirements text, not an implementation.

## Requirement Completeness

- [ ] CHK001 Are the three smoke outcomes specified as browse grid, genre inclusion and exclusion, and a Pending import row? [Completeness, Spec §FR-006]
- [ ] CHK002 Is the local entry point specified as `npm run e2e` for both the developer and CI? [Completeness, Spec §FR-001, Spec §FR-009]
- [ ] CHK003 Are the approved new files and the three existing-file edits both listed? [Completeness, Spec §FR-002]
- [ ] CHK004 Is the provider isolation specified as a loopback stub in the API network namespace, with generated `Omdb:BaseUrl`? [Completeness, Spec §FR-004]
- [ ] CHK005 Are seed count, reserved-file hold, and the fresh stack per invocation all specified? [Completeness, Spec §FR-005, Spec §FR-007]
- [ ] CHK006 Are CI retry, Chromium install, and failure-artifact retention specified together? [Completeness, Spec §FR-009]
- [ ] CHK007 Is the restored local negative proof specified, including a nonzero exit and a return to three specs? [Completeness, Spec §FR-010, Spec §SC-007]

## Requirement Clarity

- [ ] CHK008 Is the Playwright pin stated as evidence-backed and unnamed in this draft? [Clarity, Spec §FR-001]
- [ ] CHK009 Is Pending specified as the visible row before release, rather than a Pending-or-Failed window? [Clarity, Spec §FR-008]
- [ ] CHK010 Is `genreIds` tied to the genre the real control selected? [Clarity, Spec §FR-006, User Story 2]
- [ ] CHK011 Is the runtime directory named and required to be ignored? [Clarity, Spec §FR-003]
- [ ] CHK012 Is "bounded wait" paired with request or event synchronization and a ban on fixed sleeps? [Clarity, Spec §FR-008]

## Requirement Consistency

- [ ] CHK013 Does the file list in FR-002 match the frozen scope's exclusion of base compose and sample-library edits? [Consistency, Spec §FR-002, Spec §FR-011]
- [ ] CHK014 Does serial execution agree with the requirement that each spec stands without spec order? [Consistency, Spec §FR-007, User Story 2]
- [ ] CHK015 Does seeding once outside retries agree with distinct held-import paths for the initial attempt and the retry? [Consistency, Spec §FR-007, User Story 3]
- [ ] CHK016 Does the zero-real-OMDb requirement agree with the rejection of a junk key and a dead port? [Consistency, Spec §FR-004, Spec §Edge Cases]
- [ ] CHK017 Does the property-test opt-out stay worded as an opt-out and not as a pass in both FR-012 and SC-008? [Consistency, Spec §FR-012, Spec §SC-008]

## Acceptance Criteria Quality

- [ ] CHK018 Can SC-001 through SC-003 be judged from the grid, the URL, the import status code, and the Pending row? [Measurability, Spec §SC-001, Spec §SC-003]
- [ ] CHK019 Does SC-005 require the pull request to fail when a spec is red, including retention after a passing retry? [Measurability, Spec §SC-005]
- [ ] CHK020 Does SC-006 name loopback, no outbound provider call, unexpected-request failure, key redaction, and `Features.LocalPlay` false? [Measurability, Spec §SC-006]
- [ ] CHK021 Are success criteria free of a latency or volume target the brief did not set? [Measurability, Spec §Success Criteria]

## Scenario Coverage

- [ ] CHK022 Are primary flows present for browse, genre, and import as separate acceptance scenarios? [Coverage, User Story 1, User Story 2, User Story 3]
- [ ] CHK023 Is a CI retry covered as its own scenario, with seeds unchanged and the held folder changed? [Coverage, Spec §FR-007, User Story 3]
- [ ] CHK024 Is the busy `localhost:3000` refusal covered? [Coverage, Spec §Edge Cases, Spec §FR-003]
- [ ] CHK025 Is teardown on both success and failure required to remove only that invocation? [Coverage, Spec §FR-003, User Story 1]

## Edge Case Coverage

- [ ] CHK026 Is a non-loopback effective provider URL required to stop the run before seeding? [Edge Case Coverage, Spec §FR-004]
- [ ] CHK027 Is an unexpected provider request required to fail the run without forwarding? [Edge Case Coverage, Spec §Edge Cases]
- [ ] CHK028 Is the negative proof required to restore the spec and avoid a fourth committed spec? [Edge Case Coverage, Spec §FR-010]

## Non-Functional Requirements

- [ ] CHK029 Are secret handling requirements specified for generated credentials, settings, and uploaded logs? [Completeness, Spec §Edge Cases, Spec §SC-006]
- [ ] CHK030 Is `Features.LocalPlay` required to stay false in generated settings? [Completeness, Spec §FR-004]
- [ ] CHK031 Are gate-reporting outcomes specified for scope-empty skip, harness skip, mutation not-applicable, and a blocking exit 1? [Completeness, Spec §FR-012]

## Dependencies & Assumptions

- [ ] CHK032 Are DEV-321, DEV-322, DEV-325, and DEV-80 named, with a Phase B drift check rather than trust in the intake pin? [Dependency, Spec §Assumptions]
- [ ] CHK033 Is the absence of a taste assumption and of a new domain term recorded? [Assumption, Spec §Assumptions]
- [ ] CHK034 Is the isolation ADR identified as a later planning artifact rather than part of this draft? [Dependency, Spec §Assumptions]

## Ambiguities & Conflicts

- [ ] CHK035 Does the spec leave a `[NEEDS CLARIFICATION]` marker? [Ambiguity, Spec §Requirements]
- [ ] CHK036 Are the unnamed Playwright version, wait-timeout number, compose service key, and placeholder role assignment stated as unnamed because the brief does not choose them? [Ambiguity, Spec §Assumptions]
- [ ] CHK037 Does any requirement add visual regression, k6, production C#, or a public API change? [Conflict, Spec §FR-011]

## Notes

- Items stay unchecked until a reviewer reads the spec. A gap found here is `needs decision` to Keel, not a silent fill.
- This checklist tests the requirements text. It does not run the smoke suite.
